summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.76/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.76 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 8, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 1¢ lower than a week ago, 7¢ lower than a month ago, and 84¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.55) and the highest in Superior ($4.05).
